translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Ari otzimaki 18 rojarentsite Joaquín retantanakawori ipinkatharitzi, ipinkatharitaki mawa kashiri Jerusalén-ki. Oeta riniro Nehusta, rootaki rishinto Elnatán, Jerusalén-jato ini.
Roori kantacha, eenitatsi rantayitziri tee okameethatzi iñeero Tajorentsi rirori. Ari roshiyari jempe ikanta icharinipaeni paerani.
Ikanta rowayiritepaeni Nabucodonosor, pinkatharitatsiri Babilonia-ki, jateeyakini rowayiriteri Jerusalén-jatzi. Othonka itapotakiro ipankopaeni rowayirityaari.
Ikanta rowayiriteetari Jerusalén-jatzi, areetapaaka pinkathari Nabucodonosor.

Ikanta Joaquín, iwinkatharite Judá-paeni, itsipatakawo riniro, eewatziriri rowayiritepaeni, jewaripaeni, maawoeni atziri aapatziyariri, ishinetaka rayeri iwinkatharite Babilonia-jatzi. Raanakiri inampiki ikemaatsitakaawaetyaari. Rootaki awijeentsiri paerani ipinkatharitantari Nabucodonosor, tekira awijeeta osheki ojarentsi, okaatzi 8.

Ikanta pinkathari Nabucodonosor, ithonka raakiri korikipaeni pinatachari itajorentsipankoteki Tajorentsi, ikyaaki ipankoki pinkathari, raakiro maawoeni tzimatsiri. Monkaataka okaatzi ikamantantakiri paerani Tajorentsi. Ithonka ijataakiro ooronaki rowetsikakaantakiri paerani Salomón, pinkatharitatsiri Israel-ki, okaatzi owaneenkatari itajorentsipankote Tajorentsi.

Ithonka raanakiri nampitawori Jerusalén-ki, maawoeni jewaripaeni, ñaaperoripaeni owayiri, ikaatzi yotzirori rowetsikawaetzi, osheki atziri raanaki, ikaatzi 10,000. Roowiteencha raperaaterimi raanakiri maawoeni, apatziro ijeekamatsitanaki ashironkaenkaripaeni.

Imatakiri Nabucodonosor raanakiri eejatzi pinkathari Joaquín, itsipataanakiri iina, eejatzi reewarite rowayiritepaeni, riroperori atziripaeni nampitawori Jerusalén-ki. Raanakiri inampiki Nabucodonosor iiteetziro Babilonia.

Irika ikaatzi riroperori atziripaeni raanakiri iwinkatharite Babilonia-jatzi, ikaateeyini 7,000 atziri; itsipa ikaatzi 1,000 riyoyahaetziro rowetsikayitziro oeyitarika, itsipa riroperori atziripaeni, ñaaperotachari rowayiritya.
Ikanta iwinkatharite Babilonia-jatzi rowakiri ipinkatharite Matanías, riitaki poyaataariri itominthori Joaquín, rowashiñaahaeniri iwaero iiteeri Sedequías.

Iroka okaatzi rojarentsite Sedequías retantanakawori ipinkatharitzi, okaatzi 21 ojarentsi. Ipinkatharitaki Jerusalén-ki okaatzi 11 ojarentsi. Iroka owaero riniro, oeta Hamutal, rishinto Jeremías, opoñaawo roori nampitsiki iiteetziro Libna.
Tee okameethatzi iñeero Tajorentsi okaatzi rantayitziri, ari roshiyakari jempe ikanta paerani Joacim rirori.
Rootaki opoñaantari rowatsimaeri Tajorentsi, ikijakiri Jerusalén-jatzi, ari roshiyakaakiri eejatzi Judá. Tee ikoyi iñahaeri.
